algorithms.scopeApplicability: Every acceptance is project-level. NOT_REQUIRED means no direct COM snapshot or expectedScopeVersion for this root. algorithms.existingRuleCompatibility: projectId and acceptanceType must match and ruleRevisionId must equal the root's frozen rule_revision_id; do not merge merely semantically similar rules or replace origin/rule snapshots. Legacy roots without a frozen rule are not auto-upgraded.

Include the preliminary rule's own COM dependency in the prelocked dependency set. capture.transaction: Synchronous event listener in the original active Flowable/Spring same-datasource transaction; MANDATORY guard before existing PLT execute. No @Async, AFTER_COMMIT first persistence or REQUIRES_NEW capture.
capture.validation: Read real instance/definition/start user and frozen variables without a finished-only query. Do not require or fabricate endTime at this stage. Configured source/capture failure rolls back original approval transaction; no ACC call or PROJ business locks.
capture.actorId: Actual instance startUserId equal to frozen originatingActor.userId
capture.key: captureKey=AAP:{tenantId}:{processInstanceId}:{triggerRevisionId}; <=128, native instanceId<=64; preserved in full in idempotency key/request/payload/result, never put in the 64-character Outbox event_id.
capture.eventId: Canonical hyphenated UUID string, 36 characters. Generate only inside a newly reserved execute operation callback; persist it in AcceptanceApprovalCaptureResult and the same-transaction Outbox event. Never truncate/hash captureKey or generate an event ID per delivery attempt.
capture.payloadEquality: Request digest covers AcceptanceApprovalCaptureRequest only: all immutable source and trigger fields plus full captureKey, no generated eventId or new receipt timestamp. Same request replays original result; changed request conflicts.
persistAndReplay: Build CaptureRequest and its existing PLT request digest before execute; IdempotencyScope key is the full captureKey and responseType is AcceptanceApprovalCaptureResult.
Only execute's new operation callback generates eventId and returns captureKey/eventId. A duplicate completed/in-progress/conflicting reservation never runs this callback.
successFactsFactory uses that result to form AcceptanceApprovalSignalCaptured: payload repeats every request field, and payload.eventId=BusinessEvent.eventId=Outbox event_id=result.eventId.
PLT persists response_payload, audit and Outbox in the original BPM transaction. A committed retry returns the persisted result without generating another UUID or inserting another event.
If the whole transaction rolls back, no capture identity is committed; retry keeps captureKey/request and a later first successful transaction may generate a new UUID.
Consumer/ACK/retry always uses the committed short eventId; full captureKey remains a source identity, and trigger.intentKey remains the original business intent.

consume.identity: Committed exact process instance has endTime and PROCESS_STATUS=2, matching tenant/actual definition ID/key/businessKey/start user and all reserved variables. approvedAt=actual endTime. Validate envelope.eventId=payload.eventId and recompute payload.captureKey from tenant/instance/trigger revision without truncation.
consume.execution: Original actor/current authorization; frozen trigger/rule/intent never reselected. Use eventId and fixed captured payload for the outer PLT command envelope, scopeCode=PMS_ACC_APPROVAL_EXECUTE, actorId=original user. Inside new execution only, read current Owner versions, then perform ACC open business body in this same transaction without a nested command reservation.
consume.versionPolicy: Original project/tree/COM versions remain in immutable payload for audit. Only live optimistic expected versions are re-read inside a new execution; retries after committed execution replay its persisted result before reading changing facts.
consume.ack: Only after ACC+idempotency commit returning CREATED/RESOLVED_EXISTING or committed replay; then markDelivered(eventId, expectedRetryCount). Lost ACK retries original envelope and result.
consume.failure: Unknown/not ended/mismatched source, unsupported commandVersion, unavailable dependencies, revoked actor or conflict: no ACC success and no ACK; preserve payload, audit reason, scheduleRetry on same eventId. Permanent errors need Owner handling, never job-user substitution.
